_README: Singapore events that move large numbers of people onto the network.
This is a CURATED file, not a feed. There is no official API for event
crowding, so inventing one would be dishonest. What is here is split into
fixed   — the date is the same every year. Safe to ship.
moving  — the date follows a lunar or Islamic calendar and changes every
year. `date` is null until you fill it in. The app will NOT
apply an event with no date, and says so in the Sources tab.
Fill the moving dates from the official public holiday list at
public holidays dataset on https://data.gov.sg/datasets , then set
`dates` to an array of ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD).
The LOCATIONS and the effect sizes are the stable part. Deepavali fills
Little India whatever date it falls on. Those are curated from where the
celebrations actually happen, and each entry says what it is based on.
`lift` is a multiplier on the modelled crowd level at the named places,
clamped so it can never exceed a full train. It is a PRIOR: whenever LTA
PCDForecast or PCDRealTime has a measured figure for a station, the
measurement wins and this is ignored.
note: Public holidays are gazetted by MOM. Event dates were supplied by the team from public announcements and are not from an official feed — each entry says so in its basis field. Anything still without a date is listed in the app as awaiting one and is never applied to a prediction.

events.name: National Day Parade
events.basis: Parade at the Padang / Marina Bay with evening fireworks; the surrounding stations are closed or one-way for crowd control most years.
events.advice: Expect station crowd control and road closures around Marina Bay from mid-afternoon.

events.name: New Year countdown
events.basis: Countdown and fireworks at Marina Bay; trains run extended hours.
events.advice: Trains usually run late. Leaving before midnight or well after is far easier than at 00:15.

events.name: Christmas on Orchard Road
events.basis: Orchard Road light-up draws heavy evening footfall through December weekends.
events.advice: Orchard and Somerset are busiest between 19:00 and 22:00.

events.name: Thaipusam
events.dateHint: Tamil calendar, usually late January or February.
events.basis: Foot procession between temples in Little India and Tank Road; roads along the route close in stages.
events.advice: Roads along the procession route close in stages, which affects buses more than trains.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Festival
events.dateHint: Lunar calendar, usually September or early October. Not a public holiday.
events.basis: Chinatown lantern display and Gardens by the Bay mid-autumn event.
events.advice: Chinatown is busiest in the evening, particularly at weekends.

events.name: National Stadium event
events.dateHint: Add the date of any concert or match at the National Stadium. 55,000 capacity empties in about 40 minutes.
events.basis: Stadium capacity against the Circle Line's throughput at Stadium station.
events.advice: Stadium station is severe for about 40 minutes after the event ends. Mountbatten is a ten-minute walk and far easier.

events.name: National Day

events.advice: Public holiday. See the National Day Parade entry for station closures.
